public_rationale: Google's contemporaneous announcement supports the text-improvement component. The searches did not establish the reported zero successes in four attempts independently of Marcus's account. A later success or failure on a similar prompt would not establish what his four images showed. The combined claim remains unresolved.
limitations: The available text extraction does not permit inspection of the reported images.
Company claims about improvement are weaker evidence than a matched independent comparison.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Imagen 4 is far better than the original in some ways, especially text rendering, but failed all four attempts to draw a horse riding an astronaut.

statement.excerpt: It really is far better in some ways, especially in creating text (as the press person promised). But horses riding astronauts? 0 for 4:
statement.document_title: Image generation: Still crazy after all these years

our_interpretation: The surrounding comparison identifies the original 2022 Imagen as the baseline.
Text improvement means visibly more accurate and legible rendering of requested words on comparable prompts.
The four failures refer to his reported sample, not a claim that Imagen 4 can never generate this scene.
The target period is June 24–25, 2025: the post says the invitation arrived yesterday and describes tests completed before publication.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable evaluations establish improved text rendering, and independent inspection of the four authenticated outputs establishes that none depicts a horse riding an astronaut.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one of the four authenticated outputs clearly depicts a horse riding an astronaut, or a suitable comparison establishes that the claimed substantial text improvement did not occur. Contrary findings on only one component would warrant a mixed assessment if the other is established.
